saw_lines: Buyers of a composting toilet compare odours, setup and emptying before they buy, then rarely need a second one.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before a buyer reads far enough to find the answer.
Your site shows 100,000 customers worldwide, yet 0 of 30 ads carry that number. Put it in line one of every creative and open two ads with a buyer review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: Your site says More than 100,000 customers worldwide, but 0 of 30 ads carry that number. Cold buyers have no proof to act on. Put the 100,000 figure in line one of every creative and open two ads with a buyer review quote.

Your site explains how it ships, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. New buyers need that answer before they click. Lead new buyer ads with the shipping answer in line one and name the cost for their country.
6 of 24 copy ads open on “descubre trobolo wandago y wandago”, so the account leans on one story. Test two new angles against it: the €20 price drop and the camping, garden and tiny house use case.
Your site promotes free shipping, yet 0 of 24 ads mention it, so new buyers have no reason to order. Put free shipping in the first line of ads aimed at new buyers, and say it in the headline too.

ads_1: New buyer ads that answer shipping first, tested against the descubre opener
